title: SuperGLUE: A Stickier Benchmark for General-Purpose Language Understanding Systems
reasoning: The paper includes a section on 'Analyzing Gender Bias in Models' and discusses social biases and the ethical ramifications of NLP models. While the 'Quora Insincere Questions' task (which was ultimately excluded from the benchmark) deals with classifying human questions that might be disparaging or inflammatory, the core SuperGLUE benchmark tasks are not designed to evaluate a model's understanding of religion, faith, morals, or general ethical reasoning as a primary component. The mention of 'ethical' within the PAWS task instructions is part of an example text, not a task for ethical evaluation of the model.
